headline: Union counters cap with equal sharing of all media revenue
summary: The players proposed pooling media money across all 30 clubs without a cap, as MLB pressed its cap plan and offered a $1 million minimum salary a week before the CBA expires.

headline: Union uses Manfred's own words against his cap pitch
summary: The MLBPA contrasted Manfred's 2021 and 2026 claims about the players' share of revenue as the lockout nears.

headline: Manfred says MLB will not compromise on a cap and floor
summary: A rundown of the commissioner's owners-meetings remarks, including his openness to bargaining through Thanksgiving.

headline: Manfred ends owners meetings with a cap ultimatum
summary: Owners will not move off a cap and floor, Manfred said, while leaving the lockout decision until the last moment and offering to bargain through Thanksgiving.

headline: Manfred cannot imagine owners ratifying a deal without a cap and floor
summary: Details the league's 2028 cap plan and its payroll impact: 12 clubs would need to add a combined $636M to reach the floor, and 8 would need to cut $528M.

headline: Manfred and union statements point to a shutdown in two weeks
summary: Meyer says the cap would suppress salaries; Manfred says the union must move toward the middle and calls the owners' May offer serious.

headline: Union head Meyer accuses MLB of talking out of both sides of its mouth
summary: Meyer says the league has held firm on a cap since May, disputes the 50-50 revenue pitch and points to progress only on non-economic topics.

headline: MLB owners prepare for major move as lockout countdown enters final days
summary: Owners meet Nov. 17-19 on labor strategy, with a lockout expected Dec. 2; the union rejects the 2028 cap offer and wants a $1.5M minimum.
